tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the warm "tablecloth" every screen sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, inputs and menus that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented-control tracks, skeletons, photo placeholders, the neutral "Skip it" verdict.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: the one place the palette flips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons). 3:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, timestamps, placeholders. 4.5:1 on every surface and soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: THE brand color. Primary buttons, the FAB, filled rating plates, the "Order again" verdict, the logo tile. 3:1+ as a mark on every surface.

tokens.name: on-tomato
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `tomato` fill.

tokens.name: tomato-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected chips, the "Next time" note card, empty rating plates.

tokens.name: tomato-text
tokens.usage: Tomato-colored text and links on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `tomato-soft`.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Accent: "add" tweaks, highlights, the second cover block. Pair with `on-tangerine`, never white.

tokens.name: on-tangerine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `tangerine` fill.

tokens.name: tangerine-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for "add" and "swap" tweak chips and warnings.

tokens.name: tangerine-text
tokens.usage: Orange text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `tangerine-soft`; warning text.

tokens.name: yolk
tokens.usage: Pop color: the "Maybe" verdict, "new" badges, sticker highlights. Pair with `on-yolk`.

tokens.name: on-yolk
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `yolk` fill.

tokens.name: yolk-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for the "Maybe" state and gentle highlights.

tokens.name: yolk-text
tokens.usage: Yolk-family text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `yolk-soft`.

tokens.name: basil
tokens.usage: Success: saved, synced, done. Leans teal so it never relies on red-versus-green.

tokens.name: on-basil
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `basil` fill.

tokens.name: basil-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner and toast-icon background.

tokens.name: basil-text
tokens.usage: Success text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `basil-soft`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors only (delete a dish, failed save). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and invalid-field background.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: tips, sync status.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `info` fill.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner background.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `info-soft`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px from the control. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display-xl
